elements.text: Product questions Does GW5.1-BAT-D-G21 include heating?No. The GW5.1-BAT-D-G21 has no heating. The datasheet lists only aerosol fire extinguishing (integrated) for this model, while heating is optional on the GW5.1-BAT-D-G20 and GW8.3-BAT-D-G20 and integrated on the GW6.0-BAT-D-G20 and GW9.0-BAT-D-G20. The manual confirms that the optional function configuration for the GW5.1-BAT-D-G21 is "/" (not available). How many modules in one column?A single column can stack up to 6 batteries. For more energy demand or other scenarios requiring capacity expansion, contact GoodWe or a dealer to purchase a battery expansion kit.
